summary: Comprehensive testing of Mintlify-class AI documentation platform completed. Backend APIs working well (15/17 tests passed), frontend fully functional with excellent Mintlify-style design. Authentication, project management, document viewing, and AI generation all working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Test document ID not found in new project context

One of three generation types timed out, likely due to slow LLM response

Dashboard shows projects grid with 'My API Docs' project
Docs view page shows sidebar with document navigation
Document content renders markdown correctly with code blocks and syntax highlighting
AI Generator page accepts code input with language/doc type selectors
Backend authentication working with session token
Project CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Document CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
AI documentation generation (API and README types working)
Clean Mintlify-style design with proper spacing and contrast
Responsive navigation and user interface elements
Table of contents generation from markdown headings
